messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to harmonize throughput/W numbers with our HW partner before the marketplace listing. Single-page deliverable + raw telemetry contract. Who can own the kernel tuning / telemetry spec?

tyler: I can take kernel tuning and partner-side validation. Do we want to run at 512 tokens / batch or normalized to seq len 256? Also need to confirm power measurement points.

ajay: For apples-to-apples, normalize to seq=256 and report per-token p50/p90 throughput, and absolute watts measured at steady-state for a 60s window. Batch sizes: 1, 8, 32, 128. Keep quantization modes listed.

maria: Perfect. Output should include: 1) raw traces (KV hit rates + batch distribution) 2) power timeline 3) aggregated table with throughput/W. Also one-line recommendation (which config to list in marketplace). Deadline: EOD Wed for draft.

tyler: Noted. I'll open a PR with the telemetry schema and a small runbook. Quick draft of the harness command we'll use for partner runs:
```
# run perf harness
./run_harness --model redwood-7b --seq 256 --batch 32 --quant q4_0 --telemetry /tmp/tel.json --power-sample 1000
```

ajay: Nice. For kernel patches: I'll propose 3 patches: 1) fused-attn thread-tuning 2) kv-cache prefetch heuristic 3) async-copy fallback. Each will have a microbench and a perf regression test.

tyler: We'll instrument partner firmware to export power over IPMI and align timestamps with tel.json. Plan to hand them a small wrapper to translate firmware counters into our telemetry fields.

maria: Can we also include an acceptance gate for marketplace listing: delta throughput/W vs our baseline <= 8% and no functional regressions? If >8% we add a note in listing and require a canary flag.

ajay: Gate works. I'll add automated checks in the perf pipeline to compute delta vs baseline and post results to the thread.

ops-bot: Scheduled perf run started on partner-lab-12 (run id: rp-5209998). ETA ~15m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/runtime/rp-5209998

tyler: Run finished. Attaching quick summary: seq256 batch32 quant=q4_0 -> throughput 420 toks/s, steady watts 210W => 2.0 toks/s/W. p50 latency 14ms, p90 28ms. Raw tel file uploaded: s3://redwood-partners/tyler/rp-5209998/tel.json

maria: Thanks. Ajay/tyler — can you both upload the PRs: telemetry schema + kernel patch list before EOD? I'll assemble the one-slide and the marketplace blurb once both lands are green.

ajay: Yep. PR coming in 2hrs.

tyler: PR for telemetry and partner wrapper opened: https://git.redwood/partners/telemetry/pulls/14. Assigning to @ajay for review.

maria: Great job team. We'll sync Friday 9am to finalize the blurb and announcement timing. :thumbsup:
